verdict.rationale: The DGX B200's BMC exposes programmatic interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP) alongside its Web user interface, and the system offers command-line health checks and node-wide GPU administration software. Nothing documents that these APIs match everything the Web UI can do. Missing for 10: documented API-to-UI feature parity, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, coverage of Mission Control/management UI functions via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Supports Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, and Web user interface
It also provides simple commands for checking the health of the DGX B200 system from the command line.
This software enables node-wide administration of GPUs and can be used for cluster and data-center level management.
